messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] fncall/invoke error rate spike in us-west-2 on pb-prod: 5xx% up 420% over 2m, latency p95 > 2s. Pager routed to #eng-oncall.

sasha: saw it. I'm paging oncall. starting triage.

jia: looks like surge from a single tenant (acct: acme-payments) ~40k invokes/min, KV-cache misses high, GPU queues backing up.

marc: can we soft-quarantine their invocations quickly? prefer edge drop w/ 429s rather than blowing through dedup/batching.

ryan: rolling ratelimit at edge is fastest. we have runbook: edge-toggle -> plan-quota-adjust -> runtime-failover. I can push edge rule in ~90s.

liz: heads-up: ACME is on dedicated+tokenized billing, will impact them. any customer-facing comms?

jia: minimize blast: propose 3-step mitigation: 1) reduce fncall concurrency for that tenant to 4 2) enforce structured_output=false for their requests (strip function/tool call capability) 3) fallback to text-only model variant.

marc: agree. that preserves basic completions. do we have quick flag in routing to strip toolcall?

ryan: yes — runtime config flag: "disable_external_invokes" and "strip_structured_output". I'll post the command.

ryan: ```sh
# lock tenant and apply runtime soft-quarantine
redwoodctl tenants update acme-payments --set=invoke.concurrency=4 --set=invoke.disable_external_invokes=true --set=output.strip_structured=true
```

marc: executing now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Started rollout of tenant policy update acme-payments @ ryan. 1/3 hosts patched.

jia: also add an expired quota short-term: bump their per-minute token cost multiplier to 5 to throttle usage that bypasses concurrency gate.

ryan: applying quota multiplier. ```sh
redwoodctl quotas update acme-payments --rate-multiplier=5 --duration=10m
```

liz: documenting customer impact: ACME dashboard will show increased 429s for tool-invoke endpoints and fewer structured outputs. Support: prep a short note explaining deliberate degradation to preserve service for everyone.

sasha: tagging @oncall-next to assist customer comms if we handoff.

marc: rollout complete on control plane, runtime flags active on 3/3 hosts. dropping tool_invokes for tenant now.

incident-bot: Metric summary (2m after): total fncalls down 72% for tenant, system-wide 5xx rate back to baseline, p95 latency back to 450ms.

jia: that's good. keep measures for 15m then reassess. leave structured_output suppression for 30m to allow caches to warm.

liz: wrote support note draft: "We've temporarily restricted external tool/function calls and structured outputs for your workloads to mitigate an overload — engineers are monitoring and will restore full capability after system stability confirmed." want review?

marc: LGTM. add ETA window: 30min.

ryan: monitoring traces for any secondary hotspots. creating a synthetic check to verify fallback model quality for impacted routes.

deploy-bot: Quota multiplier applied successfully.

incident-bot: Silence window started for acme-payments: toolinvokes=disabled, structured_output=restricted, rate_mult=5.

sasha: switching to 3rd shift oncall in 20m — if stable, I'll handoff. otherwise escalate to eng-sre.

marc: action items: 1) keep mitigation active 15-30m 2) engineering to investigate root cause (bursting client or runaway loop) 3) support to notify ACME with draft 4) prepare rollback steps (undo flags + warm cache).

jia: adding logs to the incident channel and starting an audit of recent deployments and model variants for anomalous behavior.

liz: support will send message to ACME now and open a support ticket linking this thread.

incident-bot: Thread marked acknowledged by sasha.

marc: will update last in 20m or sooner if anything changes. :thumbsup:
